# Supplemental workbook {#sec-supplemental-workbook}

This optional workbook demonstrates material distributed with a companion or
expanded edition. It is canonical Markdown selected by the supplemental
edition manifest, not a copied chapter or a format-specific fragment.

## Workbook evidence contract {#sec-workbook-evidence-contract}

- Keep exercises useful without making them prerequisites for the core book.
- Preserve stable IDs when a supplement moves into a later full edition.
- State which edition selects every private, supplemental, or online source.
- Fail validation when an exceptional source leaks into an incompatible output.

The supplemental fixture intentionally adds no definitions or safety guidance
required by retained chapters, so omitting it leaves the core publication
complete.
